prompt: A single creature sprite for RimWorld, the fuzzrunner, a plains animal of the worn runs under the canopy. Painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline, transparent background, centered, readable at small size. Body: a plump, round, fog-fat low-slung body like a living boulder, covered in dense stone-like mottled fur in slate grey, dusty ochre and lichen-green patches with pale speckles, so it looks like a mossy rock when it holds still. Head: a smooth, blunt, wedge-shaped head sunk into the round body, with a flat brow plate and no rodent snout; the eyes are tiny vestigial slits sealed under pale lids, almost hidden in the fur. Sensory organs: dozens of long, thin, stiff sensory filaments grow in rows along the brow, the cheeks and both flanks, fanning outward and swept slightly back like a ring of antennae, longer and more numerous than ordinary whiskers; they are the way it navigates by smell and touch. Limbs: six short, stubby, padded legs, three per side, tucked beneath the belly, ending in blunt hoof-like pads; the rear carries a short tuft of filaments in place of a tail. Front view: head toward the viewer, eyes-slits and brow filaments visible. Rear view, seen from behind: the round back, the filament tuft and the haunches, the head hidden. Side views: profile showing the blunt wedge head, the flank filaments and the three legs on the near side. Same palette, mottling and proportions in every view. reference: none
